meta_title: Yachtcancun — New and pre-owned yachts for sale in Mexico
meta_desc: Yacht broker based in Cancún since 2004. New yachts from leading shipyards, pre-owned yachts in Mexico and abroad, and services for owners.

hero_1_title: Official representatives of the shipyards that define the sea.
hero_1_text: Astondoa, Fountaine Pajot, Vanquish, Iguana, Virtue and YOT, configured to your taste and delivered in Mexico.
hero_2_title: Pre-owned yachts from 30 to 200 feet, in Mexico and worldwide.
hero_2_text: Our own and third-party inventory, vetted by our team. If it isn't here, we'll find it for you.
hero_3_title: Sell or entrust your boat to the people who know it best.
hero_3_text: Brokerage, full management, maintenance and detailing. One team accountable for your boat.
intro_title: Over twenty years guiding those who choose to live the sea. Every yacht, every deal and every detail, handled by name.
intro_text: Since 2004 we have offered a professional, end-to-end and personal service for buying and selling new and pre-owned yachts from 30 to 200 feet. Clients in Mexico, the United States and Europe trust us.

sell_meta_desc: Sell your yacht with Yachtcancun: professional photo and video, digital campaigns, a buyer database built since 2004 and no fees until it sells.
sell_lead: Our marketing and production team ensures optimal visibility across multiple channels, complementing your broker's work.
sell_intro_title: Every boat is unique. We design a strategy tailored to your yacht to attract the right buyer.
sell_intro_text: We take the time to learn every detail of your boat to market it as effectively as possible. And most of our services carry no cost until the sale closes.

sell_b1_p: A service that highlights your yacht's unique qualities. We handle every detail to secure a successful, exclusive sale.
sell_b2_p: Your boat gets visibility across multiple channels, backed by a brand established in the yachting world.
sell_b3_p: A dedicated team and equipment producing compelling content of your yacht for social media and ads.
sell_b4_p: Since 2004 we have built a database of thousands of potential buyers who regularly receive newly listed boats.
sell_b5_p: Yachtcancun.com has the highest domain authority among Mexico's yachting sites and is a reference across Latin America.
sell_b6_p: Most of our services carry no cost until the sale has closed successfully.
sell_s1_t: We get to know your boat
sell_s1_p: A broker reviews the boat, its paperwork and history, and proposes an asking price based on the market.
sell_s2_p: Professional photo and video, a complete listing and, depending on the plan, a microsite and presentation video.
sell_s3_p: We publish on yachtcancun.com, social media, YouTube and campaigns to our buyers in Mexico, the US and Latin America.
sell_s4_p: We screen buyers, coordinate viewings and stay with you through delivery.
sell_sold_text: Some of the boats that have changed hands with our team.
faq1_q: How much does it cost to sell my boat with Yachtcancun?
faq1_a: Most of our services carry no cost until the sale closes. Your broker explains each plan before you sign.
faq2_q: What kind of boats do you take?
faq2_a: Motor yachts, sailboats, catamarans and special boats from 30 to 200 feet, located in Mexico or abroad.
faq3_a: On yachtcancun.com, our social media and YouTube, digital ads and regular campaigns to our buyer database.
faq4_q: What happens after I send the form?
faq4_a: A broker reviews your details and contacts you to learn about the boat and propose a sales strategy.
